interview.name: Pia
interview.answer: The repair drive is on Sunday at the community center.

reflections: Pia is coordinating the repair drive and values proactive logistical help.
Rey is reliable and focused on keeping the planning organized.
Gus is supportive and contributes concrete supplies, which helps reduce uncertainty for the group.
Pia is acting as the logistics coordinator and is repeatedly asking for confirmed details to keep the group organized.
Gus is willing to contribute concretely by bringing tools and staying flexible about additional needs.
Several people are still working from partial information, so the group is coordinating around uncertainty and waiting for confirmation on schedule and supplies.
Pia is consistently the organizer, focusing on missing logistics and keeping the group from coming up short.
Hana and the others are waiting on concrete event details before they can commit to setup or coordination.
Rosa has become the key source for final repair-drive details and is actively keeping the list organized.
Pia is acting as the main coordinator and logistics checker for the group.
Rosa is taking on an organizing role and keeping the event details centralized.
Tess and Rey are supportive participants who help with spreading the word and setting up once the details are confirmed.
Pia is coordinating the repair drive logistics and keeping everyone updated on the final time and supplies.
Tess is acting as a helpful amplifier, offering to spread updates and support last-minute logistics.
Rey and Bo are willing to help in practical ways, with Rey handling setup and Bo bringing materials like the sign-in sheet and pens.

events.text: Rey: I can help however I can—what’s the latest on the repair drive?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — I’m still trying to sort out the logistics and make sure we have enough supplies and a clear schedule. If you can help with organizing the drop-off times, that would really ease my mind.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Rey: Absolutely — I can help organize the drop-off times. Send me whatever details you have, and I’ll keep it tidy.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring over a few tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus. Could you let me know which tools you’re bringing so I can make sure we don’t end up short on anything?
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Gus: I’ll bring a hammer, a screwdriver set, a tape measure, and my cordless drill. If you still need anything else, I can grab that too.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — could you tell me what’s confirmed for the repair drive so I can check we’re not missing anything? I’m trying to keep the logistics straight.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Jules: Hi Eli — I’m still just going by what I heard, but it sounds like the repair drive is still on for Saturday. If you know for sure, I could use an extra volunteer or a basic tool kit.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Pia: Thanks — Saturday sounds right, but I still need the confirmed volunteer and tool list so I can keep us from coming up short.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — I’m still waiting on the start time and whether I need to bring anything specific.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the start time and what, if anything, we need to bring. Once that’s settled, I can make sure the logistics line up.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Pia — once we have the start time and any bring-alongs confirmed, I’ll line up the details too.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Opal — what’s confirmed so far for the repair drive? I want to make sure we’re not missing anything logistically.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Opal: I only know that I’m keeping an eye on where the repair drive is being held, but I haven’t confirmed the first stop yet. If you want, I can check the location details next.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Pia: Yes please — if you can check the location details, that’d help me keep everything straight.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Rosa: Yes—it's now on Sunday at the community center. If you need anything brought or fixed, send it my way and I’ll keep the list organized.
events.speaker: Rosa

prov.value: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center helps a lot. I’ll keep track of what’s needed and send you anything we should bring or fix.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you, Pia — I really appreciate it. I’ll keep the list organized, and let me know if anything comes up.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Tess: Oh, that’s great to hear — if you’re coordinating, I can spread the word that school pickup timing works too. Sounds like the repair drive is really coming together nicely!
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — the latest is Sunday at the community center now. I’m just double-checking the logistics so we don’t miss anything.
events.speaker: Pia

prov.value: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Tess: Oh good, Sunday at the community center works — I’ll pass that along and mention school pickup timing is flexible too. If you want, I can help spread any last-minute logistics.

events.text: Rey: That works for me — I’ll help set up and organize the supplies on Sunday at the community center. Just tell me what time to be there.
